_stop_rules.mechanism: A stop TOUCHES <case>/ABORT. The stop_on_rule function object (type abort, libs (utilityFunctionObjects), action writeNow) then makes the solver WRITE ITS FIELDS and end itself at the end of the current iteration. NO SIGNAL IS SENT TO ANY RANK. That is deliberate: the pre-reboot run was lost because its wrapper took SIGKILL and left four orphaned ranks running for 12.9 hours.
_stop_rules.R1_residual_growth: mean(last 100)/min(last 400) > 2.0 on any of Ux, T, p_rgh -> STOP. The threshold is analyse_k2g.py's own RES_RISE_MAX, so the monitor stops on exactly the condition the comparator would later refuse on.
_stop_rules.R2_field_out_of_bounds: any non-finite residual, or |DP_module| > 1000 m2/s2 (36x the two measured levels, 27.189 and 27.730) -> STOP.
_stop_rules.R3_plateau_with_a_stalled_linear_solver: DP_module moving less than 1e-5 over 500 iterations WHILE the p_rgh solver is at its iteration cap in >= 90 of the last 100 iterations -> STOP AND CLIMB THE LADDER: mesh -> numerics -> model. Do not relax the solver; a plateau with the pressure solver at its cap is the wall-layer/mesh signature.
_stop_rules.R4_coherent_oscillation: >= 6 sign changes of the DP_module increment over 300 iterations with peak-to-peak above 1e-2 m2/s2 -> STOP, PHYSICS VOTING UNSTEADY. A steady SIMPLE solve is the wrong instrument for that state.
_stop_rules.one_change_per_run: Directive item 13. Every fired rule is appended to ACTION_HISTORY.K2f_L3.tsv and a rule that has fired once in this run NEVER fires again. Two stops on the same cause climb the ladder; the ladder exhausted parks the rung with its action history and a lesson.
